name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Placeholder blocks for content that is loading. Hidden from assistive technology; the container carries aria-busy.

aria: Set aria-busy="true" on the region that is loading, and announce completion with a live region
a11y.notes: Static item: not focusable and no key interaction of its own. Do not use it as the only loading signal for long waits; add a text status.
